test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Six students, Maira, Amaira, Sara, Zara, Tara and Kiara, are made to sit against a wall. All of them are facing north.

Amaira is sitting 2ⁿd to the left of Maira.

Sara is sitting 4th to the right of Tara.

Kiara is sitting to the immediate left of Amaira.

Tara is sitting at one of the ends.

Which 2 students are sitting at the extreme ends?
solution:
**Given: **Six students, Maira, Amaira, Sara, Zara, Tara and Kiara, are made to sit against a wall. All of them are facing north.

1) Tara is sitting at one of the ends.

2) Sara is sitting 4th to the right of Tara. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b00560332972b111b1cf3a7294d66fb48e445e069798de121127179076a695a3.png] 

3) Amaira is sitting 2nd to the left of Maira.

4) Kiara is sitting to the immediate left of Amaira.

After positioning Amaira, Maira and Kiara only one position is left which will be occupied by the only student left i.e. Zara.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6148235bbd01fa5b2370efc4b4060fca63d1e93ba33a9008585afd06e54d6efc.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Tara and Maira are sitting at the extreme ends.

Hence, **"Option 2" **is the correct answer.
